title: Tiramisu
steps: Combine egg yolks and sugar in a double boiler over boiling water. Reduce heat to low and cook about 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Add 1 Tbsp brandy toward the end.
Remove from heat and whip until thick and pale yellow. Beat in the mascarpone.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks in a separate bowl. Gently fold one-third into the yolk mixture, then fold in the rest.
Line a large rectangular dish with ladyfingers and brush generously with coffee liqueur. Spoon half the cream over the ladyfingers and dust with cocoa.
Repeat the ladyfinger, coffee liqueur and cream layers. Garnish with cocoa or chocolate curls. Refrigerate overnight or at least a few hours.
